Implant Restorations

Custom abutments and implant-retained crowns and bridges, screw- or cement-retained. Tell us the system and platform and we take it from scan body to finished restoration.

Download RX forms

What we make

  • Screw-retainedRetrievable restorations on a ti-base or custom abutment.
  • Cement-retainedA custom abutment with a separate crown.
  • Full-archFour or six implants: see All-on-4 / All-on-6.

How it works

  1. SendScan, impressions or drop-off, with a completed RX form.
  2. DesignPlanned and designed in CAD/CAM to your prescription.
  3. MakeMade in the lab, then finished and checked by hand.
  4. ReturnBack to your clinic by track-and-trace courier or drop-off.

What to send us

  • Scan with scan bodies, or impression copings and analogs
  • Implant system, platform and connection on the RX form
  • Opposing arch and bite registration
  • Shade and any photos

Questions

Which implant systems can you restore?

Note the implant system and platform on the RX form. If you are unsure whether we support a system, call the lab before sending the case.

Screw-retained or cement-retained?

Both. Screw-retained is easier to retrieve; cement-retained suits some angulations and aesthetics. We build to your prescription.

Do you make full-arch implant prostheses?

Yes. See All-on-4 / All-on-6 for full-arch work on four or six implants.

Other services

  • Crown & BridgeSingle crowns to multi-unit bridges, designed from your scan and finished by hand at the bench.
  • All-on-4 & All-on-6Full-arch implant prostheses on four or six implants.
  • Orthodontic AppliancesRetainers, night guards and clear aligners, made to your prescription.
  • Surgical GuidesGuides that transfer your implant plan to the mouth for more predictable placement.
  • Smile DesignDigital Smile Design blueprints and wearable mock-ups before treatment starts.
